Sinner surges +0.060 (0.410 -> 0.470), Fritz trims slightly to 0.170, Cobolli climbs to #3 at 0.125 (higher conditional Bottom-Match-1 rate when Fery exits), Djokovic rises +0.030 to 0.115 (cleared FAA), and fatigued Zverev drops -0.030 to 0.105. Top-5 sum = 0.985, leaving 0.015 for 6th remaining player Arthur Fery.
